content.summary: A lighthouse mascot loops one compass-disc pocket illusion. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One mascot identity and one handheld prop remain fixed. + The prop follows a readable hand-to-opening path. + Only simple repeatable steps accompany the illusion. + The stage and silhouette do not reset. + The final prop position matches a clean loop point.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one original cobalt plush lighthouse mascot alone on a charcoal stage holding one brass compass disc. Alternate the disc between both hands and the pocket opening to create one clear disappearance-and-return illusion. Return the compass disc to a centered two-hand hold and freeze one loop-ready pose.
